architecture_contract.method: paired RNA-ATAC multimodal variational autoencoder with modality-specific RNA and ATAC encoders, a joint self-attention encoder, a joint decoder, Gaussian-mixture latent prior, and optional classifier
architecture_contract.rna_only_candidate: The frozen RNA encoder mean can support a common benchmark head. The released optional classifier is driven by the joint latent and is not an RNA-only native classifier.
architecture_contract.profile_limitation: The joint decoder is trained and called from a joint latent inferred from both RNA and ATAC. The released inference method also derives ATAC library size from observed ATAC.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No remotely hosted demonstration checkpoint is admitted. Fit one local model per outer fold and seed from permitted outer-training same-cell or same-nucleus pairs.

inductive_inference_contract.allowed_wrapper: Align query RNA to the frozen training gene inventory and call only the frozen RNA encoder in eval/no-grad mode, returning its deterministic posterior mean to an independently frozen common head.
inductive_inference_contract.forbidden: Do not pass fabricated zero ATAC, observed held ATAC, query-derived ATAC library size, or query rows into training, GMM initialization, feature selection, early stopping, or classifier fitting.
inductive_inference_contract.upstream_profile_audit: get_sample_rate, get_sample_scale, inference, and MultiPosterior.imputation all require x=[x_rna,x_atac]. inference logs both assays, evaluates the ATAC encoder and joint encoder, and computes log observed ATAC depth. Therefore its ATAC output is reconstruction/imputation conditional on observed ATAC, not RNA-conditioned ATAC.
inductive_inference_contract.query_state: Every module must be forced to eval mode because the network contains BatchNorm and dropout. Query order and batch composition must not change another query prediction.

input_contract.atac: nonnegative peak-count matrix attached as a CellMeasurement with the same row order and cell count as RNA
input_contract.pairing_requirement: Core multimodal training requires row-paired assays. Only validated same-cell or same-nucleus observations are allowed.
input_contract.reference: GENCODE v49 stable genes and GRCh38.p14 0-based half-open peak identifiers, with feature order frozen inside each outer fold
input_contract.rna: nonnegative UMI counts; the model applies log1p internally but no normative assay-wide normalization

missingness_contract.native: The multimodal path requires both tensors for each row and does not accept an absent modality or project missing-state mask.
missingness_contract.inference: RNA-only cell-state embedding uses the RNA encoder alone. Missing ATAC is absent, never a zero tensor.
missingness_contract.project_mapping: Preserve all eight project missingness states outside scMVP; only observed paired assays enter multimodal training.

output_contract.cell_embedding: frozen RNA-encoder posterior mean for an RNA-only query; joint, RNA, and ATAC latent outputs must be named separately
output_contract.not_admitted: p_atac_scale and p_atac_mean are conditional on observed ATAC and cannot enter the RNA-conditioned ATAC profile leaderboard

runtime_contract.upstream_hardware: README reports GTX 1080Ti/CUDA 10.2 and RTX 3090/CUDA 11.2 testing

safe_loading_contract.required_artifacts: Project-fitted state dict with exact hash/key/shape/dtype manifest, architecture, feature orders, GMM state, preprocessing state, head, fold, and seed. Do not load upstream trainer pickle files.

source_evidence: The exact repository revision, MIT license, setup metadata, and relevant public source files were inspected as text on 2026-08-22. Hosted datasets, trainer pickle files, packages, dependencies, and weights were not downloaded, installed, deserialized, or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Candidate through a frozen RNA-encoder mean and common head after pairing, query-isolation, runtime, and leakage fixtures pass.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Ineligible and latent-only because every released ATAC reconstruction path consumes observed ATAC.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because scMVP has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
